input_fields.name: standard_direction
input_fields.description: One requested standard direction such as front, back, left, right, top, bottom, isometric, or trimetric.

input_fields.name: model_coordinate_frame
input_fields.description: Confirmed model coordinate frame used to interpret the standard direction.

result_fields.name: standard_view_state
result_fields.description: Requested direction, coordinate frame, observed camera orientation, and geometry-unchanged state.

procedure: Validate standard_direction and bind it to model_coordinate_frame; do not use an unlabelled pixel direction.
Issue one verified View-control/orientation-indicator standard-view command.
Observe the camera direction/indicator and return standard_view_state.
If the view label or coordinate-frame relation is ambiguous, stop with needs_manual_review.
rejection_rules: Reject an unknown standard direction, missing coordinate frame, unavailable View control, or a camera state that cannot be observed.
Do not treat a visually similar direction as exact agreement.
Do not rotate model geometry to obtain a view.
